changed_paragraphs.before: When a language model is used to evaluate answers, the evaluator itself becomes an object of assessment. Multilingual studies already examine this problem: Fu and Liu evaluate judgments on parallel language versions, while Chung and Freienthal investigate cross-language stability in controlled customer-support dialogues. Their work provides direct precedents for studying language-dependent evaluation, rather than a basis for claiming that multilingual judging has been overlooked. [[S01]]; [[S02]].
changed_paragraphs.after: When a language model is used to evaluate answers, the evaluator itself becomes an object of assessment. Multilingual studies already examine language-dependent evaluation by language-model judges: Fu and Liu evaluate judgments on parallel language versions, while Chung and Freienthal investigate cross-language stability in controlled customer-support dialogues. Their work provides direct precedents for studying language-dependent evaluation, rather than a basis for claiming that multilingual judging has been overlooked. [[S01]]; [[S02]].

changed_paragraphs.before: Judging-instruction language also needs to be distinguished from the language of the evaluated content. Yu et al. compare an official English prompt with basic and instructional Chinese prompts, which vary in detail as well as language. Chung and Freienthal include an Estonian instruction-language sensitivity check. Our secondary condition follows this existing line of inquiry but aims to preserve rubric meaning while changing instruction language. [[S05]]; [[S06]].
changed_paragraphs.after: Judging-instruction language also needs to be distinguished from the language of the evaluated content. hard_case.original: The planned pilot contains 20 underlying passage–question items. Each item will have a correct answer and a minimally altered incorrect answer in both languages, yielding 80 response texts before exclusions. Incorrect variants will change a substantive entity, quantity or relation while keeping the answer form as similar as practical. Human review will verify that a variant is actually incorrect rather than an alternative valid expression.
